description: A man in a black tricorn hat and dark coat with brass buttons stands on the snowy deck of a wooden sailing ship, gripping a dark, tattered cloth on a rope. Above him a striped red-and-white flag with a Union Jack in the upper corner flies from the mast. Behind are a stormy grey sky, masts and rigging, a second ship and a snowy harbour town. The scene is 18th-century maritime, with no visible text, border or frame.
